Intel Resource and Design Center Registration Email Template
Pending Approval
Welcome {!Contact.Name},
Thank you for registering for a Developer Zone Premier Account.
If you don't yet have a Corporate Non-Disclosure Agreement (CNDA) signed with Intel, it may take up to 10 working days to review your Premier Account request. You will receive a status update within 3 business days.
While your Premier Account application is being reviewed, you can access Intel's Developer Zone immediately as a Standard user.
Username: {!Contact.Core_Login_Id__c} Email Address: {!Contact.Email}
Please retain this email for future reference.
Your password should be protected as confidential. Your use of the password and Intel's websites are governed by Intel's Terms of Use linked from the bottom of each respective site's web pages.
If you have any questions, please contact us.
To manage your profile, including available marketing subscriptions, please visit My Intel.
Please DO NOT reply to this e-mail message. This is an automated response. To ensure that you continue receiving our e-mails, add us to your address book.
Intel is committed to protecting your privacy. For more Information, please see the Intel Privacy Notice. Intel Cookie Notice.
